Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Python BackEnd Developer position. We regret to inform you that your application is not moving forward, as your CV does not meet the required must-have qualifications: at least 5 years of software development experience, 2 years of experience developing big systems with Python, and experience with asynchronous programming for performance-critical applications.

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
